entities.name: PMID:25085473
observations: EURO-URHIS 2 cross-sectional study of non-institutionalized adults aged ≥65 in Slovak cities (n=665) and Dutch cities (n=795); neighbourhood deprivation measured by unemployment rate; multilevel logistic regression assessed smoking, binge drinking, physical activity, fruit/vegetable intake, and BMI.

entities.name: Country-specific unemployment gradients
observations: Among older urban residents, no measured health-risk behaviour was associated with neighbourhood unemployment in Slovakia. In the Netherlands, residents of least-favourable versus most-favourable neighbourhoods had higher odds of daily smoking (OR 2.32, 95% CI 1.25–4.30) and overweight (OR 1.84, 95% CI 1.24–2.75). Individual socioeconomic position explained the smoking and physical-activity country differences, but not the overweight difference.
